name: How does the local Denver metro climate affect bathroom door frames?

mainEntity.name: How does the local Denver metro climate affect bathroom door frames?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Denver metro area, including communities like Centennial, Parker, and Greenwood Village, wide seasonal humidity swings frequently accelerate door frame problems. Winter heating creates very dry indoor air, which causes wood framing to shrink, while summer moisture and daily hot bathroom showers cause rapid expansion. This sharp contrast stresses wood joints, breaks paint seals, and loosens jamb fasteners. When repairing bathroom frames in this climate, contractors typically use kiln-dried lumber, allow adequate movement margins, secure deep screws into framing, and apply durable, sealed finishes to endure these cycling conditions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Dry winters and humid summer or shower conditions cause severe wood expansion and contraction, loosening joints and cracking paint seals on bathroom frames.
